title: Rock paper scissors against the computer
when: The user wants rock paper scissors against the computer, with rounds, a match score and maybe a computer that adapts.
prompt:
Goal: A quick, fair round loop with clear results and an optional opponent that learns the player habits.
Steps:
1. logic.mjs: BEATS = { rock: "scissors", paper: "rock", scissors: "paper" }; outcome(a, b) returns win, lose or draw.
2. Computer pick: uniform random by default; Adaptive mode predicts the player most frequent next move after their last one and counters it.
3. Match best of 3, 5 or 7: first to ceil(n / 2); matchWinner(score, n).
4. Three large buttons with text and icon; keys R, P, S.
5. Reveal with a short shake animation, none under prefers-reduced-motion; result sentence in aria-live: "Rock beats scissors. You win the round."
6. Round history list and overall stats in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: all 9 pairs, match winner, adaptive counter pick.
Quality bar:
- Result is a sentence, not only an icon.
- Score always visible.
- One handed on phones.
Pitfalls:
- A computer that sees the player move before choosing in fair mode.
- Draws counted as wins.
- Animations that block the next round.
Verify:
- [ ] Outcome table tested.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule present.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (rules and picks), test.mjs.

examples.output: three buttons, "You 2 x 1 Computer", adaptive mode toggle
